overall: The AG found the Board handled the minutes request properly but violated the OML by convening in executive session for an improper purpose and by failing to periodically review its executive session minutes; the Board was ordered to release the minutes in full, subject to exemptions.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board improperly withheld portions of its April 11, 2011 executive session minutes after his January 13, 2013 request.
allegations.key_passage: This process complied with the law's requirement that a review be performed within 30 days of a request.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board failed to timely approve its April 11, 2011 executive session minutes, which were approved more than a year and a half later.
allegations.key_passage: We recommend that executive session minutes be approved in a timely manner as well.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board failed to timely release the April 2011 executive session minutes upon his request.
allegations.key_passage: This process complied with the law's requirement that a review be performed within 30 days of a request.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board improperly convened in executive session on April 11, 2011 to discuss the Symmes and Mugar properties.
allegations.key_passage: While the Board acted appropriately in reviewing the request, we find the executive session recorded in the minutes requested was improper.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board failed to regularly review its executive session minutes to determine whether continued nondisclosure was warranted.
allegations.key_passage: Because the Board did not conduct such a periodic review, it failed to comply with this requirement.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board generally failed to timely approve its executive session minutes, a broad allegation not tied to one meeting.
allegations.key_passage: We decline to review this allegation as our office will not conduct broad audits of public bodies based on generalized allegations.

remedy: Release the April 11, 2011 executive session minutes in their entirety, unless the attorney/client privilege or an exemption to the Public Records Law applies.
Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law; the Board was cautioned that a future similar violation may be evidence of an intentional violation.
remedy_passage: Accordingly, we order the Board to release the April 11, 2011 executive session minutes in their entirety, unless the attorney/client privilege or an exemption to the Public Records Law applies.
